title: LIGHT DRIVE
description: An endless first-person night drive. Brake against a creeping accelerator, fight tunnel vision and fast eyelid blinks over the windshield, and collect rare neon road arrows to wake up. Sleep never ends the drive by itself; a lucky animal hit can wake you but adds lasting drift damage. There is no hit-count limit. Animated wildlife, four palettes, soft piezo sound and rumble. Distance, wake-ups, avoided animals and an SD high score.

buttons.action: Left/right: steer; title: palette. Up: sound, Down: rumble on title/pause.
Start, retry and confirm; neon recovery is automatic when driving over road arrows
Hold to brake against the creeping accelerator; title: help; pause: end drive
Cycle Night Red, Amber, Deep Blue and Violet
Pause/resume; hold 3 seconds for console menu
